summary: Preserve observed checkout identity and terminal retirement across registration snapshots (#337)

delivery.outcome: Unknown or previously registered checkouts cannot disappear or change identity across an adjacent journal transition without a matching retained terminal binding.
nonGoals: No deletion authority, filesystem mutation or receipt authentication is added to this read-only checker.
No package-manifest, allocator or foreign branch changes; mandatory installer/controller remain separate integration work.

architecture.decision: Compare inventory identity across adjacent snapshots and accept disappearance only for a previously bound checkout whose retained current request has a terminal state and receipt; unknown observations require reconciliation first.
dataChanges: Tighten consistency of existing v1 snapshots without changing their schema.
architecture.rollback: Revert this checker/test/documentation delta without changing stored snapshots.

validation.evidence: A pending orphan snapshot became complete after silent inventory removal on the accepted base; negative regression must fail before correction.
